rather than the current value of the counter.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
MAC source address. Bit[31:16] are reserved.
MAC source address is consisted by
{MAC_SA_HI[15:0],MAC_SA_LO[31:0]}

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

Bit[15:0] is used to specify the pause timer field.
Bit[31:16] are reserved.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[9:0] is used to specify the number of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[9:0] is used to specify the number of
transmit clock cycles in 1 microsecond, it is
used to measure wake-up time.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify number of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify number of
microseconds for transmit wakeup time.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify number of
microseconds for receive wakeup time.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[31:16] is Reserved.
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[31:16] is Reserved.
Bit[15:0] is used to set pause timer almost done
threshold, when pause timer count down
reaches to this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_*F*_PAUSE_TIMER_ALDONE_
O will be asserted.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[31:16] is Reserved.
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

MAC TX/RX can identify frame as QTAG frame

Bit[0] = TX data path reset.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
MAC source address. Bit[31:16] are reserved.
MAC source address is consisted by

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[31:0] = DMAC_PS_ADDR[31:0]. When
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[31:4] = Reserved.
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

Bit[2] = Resynchronize TX timestamp.
Bit[1] = RX data path reset.
Bit[0] = TX data path reset.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

address which is a 48-bit pattern.

set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
MAC source address. Bit[31:16] are reserved.
MAC source address is consisted by
{MAC_SA_HI[15:0],MAC_SA_LO[31:0]}

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of

Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.

0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.

receive side.

0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
MAC source address. Bit[31:16] are reserved.
MAC source address is consisted by
{MAC_SA_HI[15:0],MAC_SA_LO[31:0]}

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the pause timer field.
Bit[31:16] are reserved.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

address which is a 48-bit pattern.

value of 4'hf to indicate speed mode is not being
configured.

[14] Latched high BER
[13:8] BER
[7:0] Errored blocks

keep high/low until it was read.
[13:8] record ber counter value, when it updates to over
the max value, it'll keep to 6'h3f and not roll over.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: FEC Status0 Register
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
FEC Status0 Register
[15:0] Indicate lane 15~10 is locked.
For 10G/25G FEC bypass/40G, it indicates a pcs
block lock, and for other mode, it means alignment
marker are locked for this lane.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: FEC Status1 Register
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
FEC Status1 Register
[15:9] Reserved.
[8] Align Status
[7] Reserved
[6] Local Degraded SER received
[5] Remote degraded SER received
[4] FEC degraded SER
[3] FEC degraded SER ability
[2] FEC high SER
[1] FEC bypass indication ability
[0] FEC bypass correction ability
CEPCS core can support both FEC bypass indicate
for all speed mode and bypass correction for
100G/50G/25G.
For all register field with a LH attribute, the value will
keep high until it was read.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: FEC corrected codewords counter Register
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
FEC corrected codewords counter Register
[15:0] FEC corrected codewords upper count.
These bits will keep 1 in case of overflow.
When registers FEC corrected codewords lower
counter and FEC corrected codewords upper
counter are used to read the 32-bit counter value, the
register lower is read first, the value of the upper is
latched when (and only when) register lower is read,
and reads of register higher return the latched value
rather than the current value of the counter.

Deskew FIFO burst read threshold register
deskew FIFO burst read threshold
deskew FIFO will insert idle cycle if the FIFO
have a n cycles burst read.
For 400G/200G, the default value is 16'h07. For
100GR2, the default value is 16'h05. Other

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.shortDesc: FEC corrected codewords counter Register
indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
FEC corrected codewords counter Register
[15:0] FEC corrected codewords lower count.
These bits will keep 1 in case of overflow.
When registers FEC corrected codewords lower
counter and FEC corrected codewords upper counter
are used to read the 32-bit counter value, the register
lower is read first, the value of the upper is latched
when (and only when) register lower is read, and
reads of register higher return the latched value
rather than the current value of the counter.

[5] Remote degraded SER received

for all speed mode and bypass correction for
100G/50G/25G.

keep high until it was read.

indirect\u001fEMU_NP_CLUSTER\u001fNP_HE_.fullDesc:
FEC corrected codewords counter Register
[15:0] FEC corrected codewords lower count.
These bits will keep 1 in case of overflow.
When registers FEC corrected codewords lower
counter and FEC corrected codewords upper counter
are used to read the 32-bit counter value, the register
lower is read first, the value of the upper is latched
when (and only when) register lower is read, and
reads of register higher return the latched value
rather than the current value of the counter.

These bits will keep 1 in case of overflow.
When registers FEC corrected codewords lower
counter and FEC corrected codewords upper counter

lower is read first, the value of the upper is latched
when (and only when) register lower is read, and
reads of register higher return the latched value
rather than the current value of the counter.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:

address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: MAC core general control and configuration
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc: MAC core general control and configuration

fields.indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f:
1 = MAC core running at 400G (400G MAC) or 100G (100G MAC).
0 = MAC core ruining at 200G (200G MAC) or 10/25/40/50G (100G
MAC)

Select MAC RS protocols
1 = MAC RS comply with 10G/25G protocol defined in IEEE802.3 Clause
46.
0 = MAC RS comply with 40G/50G/100G protocol defined in IEEE802.3
Clause 81.
Please note do not set this bit to 1 for 400G MAC core.

MAC loopback mode enablement
1 = enable loopback mode.
0 = disable loopback mode.

Truncate frames enablement for both TX and RX path.
1 = Truncate the frame with the length more than configured max length
0 = Not truncate the frame with the length more than configured max
length

Jumbo frame enablement.
1 = Enable Jumbo frames with the length up to the value defined in
JUMBO_LENGTH (0x04)
2 = Disable Jumbo frames

VLAN Q-tagged frame enablement for both TX and RX path. Please note
CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor tag field for
statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.
0 = Disable VLAN Q-tagged frame detection.

Double VLAN Q-tagged (QinQ) frame enablement for both TX and RX
path. Please note CEMAC does not insert tag field, CEMAC only monitor
tag field for statistic purpose & identify the packet length.
1 = Enable VLAN Double Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.
0 = Disable double VLAN Q-tagged frame detection and VLAN Q-tagged
frame detection.

Normal pause packet enablement. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX/RX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable normal pause packet.
0 = Disable normal pause packet.

CEMAC stop to get new frame from FIFO when received normal pause
packet.
1 = Enable pause stop mode.
0 = Disable pause stop mode.

PFC packet enablement on TX path. Include:
<1> TX pause frame self-assemble
<2> TX done/almost done indication
1 = Enable PFC packet on TX path.
0 = Disable PFC packet on TX path.

PFC packet enablement on RX path. Include:
RX done/almost done indication

Enablement for deficit idle count based IPG mode
1 = Enable DIC mode on RX path.
0 = Disable DIC mode on RX path.

Stripe PAD field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe PAD field from received frames

Stripe CRC field from received frames.
1 = Enable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames.
0 = Disable MAC to stripe CRC field from received frames

1 = MAC continues to operate transmit even received link fault indication
from receive side.
0 = MAC send link fault sequence instead of sending packets on transmit
side when receive link fault indication.

0 = MAC continue to operate transmit even received LPI indication from
receive side.
1 = MAC stop sending packets on transmit side when receive LPI
indication.

1 = Reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.
0 = Not reset TX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed or underflowed.

1 = Reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.
0 = Not reset RX FIFO when FIFO is overflowed.

1 = Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame by marking as error frame
0 = Not Discard all received PAUSE/PFC frame
LPI request valid. Mac will generate LPI pattern on MII interface.

When assemble and Send Pause/PFC by CEMAC, timer value uses:
1 = Pause/PFC use the timer from CEMAC interface.
0 = Pause/PFC use the timer from register.

1 = higig is enabled.
0 = higig is not enabled.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_RDY_O will be de-asserted
to inform user logic stop writing TX FIFO. The
value of almost full threshold should not
configure more than 8.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_TF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to speed up or
restart writing to TX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to set almost full threshold,
when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALFULL_O will be
asserted to inform user logic speed up reading
RX FIFO.
Bit[31:16] is used to set almost empty
threshold, when FIFO reaches this threshold,
CEMAC_*G_RF*_FF_ALEMPT_O will be
asserted, user logic may need to slow down or
stop reading RX FIFO.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC TX. MAC core can
support the size up to 32K bytes, and will not
truncate frame on TX side if exceed the max
frame length, but may not correctly counted in
statistic registers.
Bit[31:16] specify the max frame length
supported by this MAC RX, will truncate frame
on RX side if exceed the max frame length, and
report the error to user logic through pin
CEMAC_*G_RF*_STATUS_O
If set to 0, MAC core use the length specified
by pin CEMAC_CFG_JUMBO_LEN_I[14:0].

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Specify the lower 32 bits of MAC source
address which is a 48-bit pattern.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the higher 16 bits of
MAC source address. Bit[31:16] are reserved.
MAC source address is consisted by
{MAC_SA_HI[15:0],MAC_SA_LO[31:0]}

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[7:0] is used to specify the length of Inter
Packet Gap(IPG), default value is 12, can be
set 8~24.
Bit[14:8] reserved, always 0.
Bit[15] AM IPG Compensation Mode enable.
Bit[31:16] is used to specify the interval of AM
IPG Compensation. Please refer 3.1.7.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[15:0] is used to specify the pause timer field.
Bit[31:16] are reserved.

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:

indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.shortDesc: Bit[31:4] = Reserved.
indirect\u001fMACW_MAC\u001fMAC_IP\u001f.fullDesc:
Bit[31:4] = Reserved.

Bit[2] = Resynchronize TX timestamp.
Bit[1] = RX data path reset.
Bit[0] = TX data path reset.
